question: Should OpenClaw core support native per-task model hints in HEARTBEAT.md, or should heartbeat model routing remain per-turn/plugin-owned or move into the cron/job-level override track?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but solving it changes public HEARTBEAT.md syntax, provider/model precedence, shared-session behavior, and the boundary between core scheduler logic and plugin-owned routing.

options.title: Keep routing per-turn/plugin-owned
options.body: Document that heartbeat runs are one model-routed turn today and use `before_model_resolve` or ClawHub plugins for whole-turn routing unless maintainers explicitly sponsor native task splitting.

options.title: Add native HEARTBEAT.md hints
options.body: Define model/provider fields in task blocks, split due tasks by effective model, and add tests/docs for precedence, timestamps, and session restoration.

options.title: Fold into cron override work
options.body: Make the open cron/job-level model override issue the canonical scheduled-routing contract and avoid heartbeat-specific syntax until the scheduling model converges.

recommendation.title: Keep routing per-turn/plugin-owned
recommendation.body: Document that heartbeat runs are one model-routed turn today and use `before_model_resolve` or ClawHub plugins for whole-turn routing unless maintainers explicitly sponsor native task splitting.
